variants.headline: Party leader faces a challenge
variants.body: The leader of {party} is being challenged. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.

variants.headline: Leadership becomes a contested question

variants.headline: A challenge inside the party
variants.body: Leadership of the party {party} is under challenge. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.
